registration_timing: after sealed v0.2.1 data-order outcomes and censoring correction, before any checkpoint-splice or extended-horizon outcome
status_label: checkpoint splice of post-E2048 order suffixes plus D211 censoring extension
claim_scope: causal continuation test within one post-outcome-selected R64 residual-loop construction; no intrinsic-boundary, Transformer, task-performance, asymptotic, or general data-order claim

frozen_training.chunk_strategy: one checkpoint continuation arm at a time

integrity_gate.arm: S211 state plus D211 suffix from E2048 to E4096
integrity_gate.model_state: tensor exact against sealed D211 E4096 checkpoint
integrity_gate.optimizer_state: tensor exact against sealed D211 E4096 checkpoint

registered_endpoints.suffix_controlled_exit: both S211->D223 and S211->D227 recover by E4096 and reciprocal S223->D211 does not
registered_endpoints.prehistory_controlled_exit: neither S211 forward transfer recovers by E4096 and reciprocal S223->D211 does
registered_endpoints.delayed_recovery: unchanged S211->D211 reaches the recovery rule by a measured checkpoint at or before E8192
registered_endpoints.continued_censoring: unchanged S211->D211 remains below the recovery rule through E8192

claim_boundary: The splice intervenes on deterministic post-E2048 batch suffix identity while holding the source model and optimizer checkpoint fixed, and the reciprocal arm tests prehistory dependence. It can causally localize exit control within this one R64 construction but cannot identify a single causal batch, establish an intrinsic stability boundary, or generalize to Transformers, task performance, asymptotic depth, or other task families.

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
